purpose: Declare which skills must carry an eval runner. run_all_skill_evals.py discovers runners by glob, so a skill without a runner is otherwise skipped silently while the log still reports a full pass. Only entries listed as required fail the build when their runner is missing.
runner_nature: Static contract regression checks. They assert that the contract wording a skill must keep is still present, not that a model behaves correctly.

planned.note: Gains a motion handoff contract and must not bind to new skill internal paths.
Gains a two-axis preceding-input contract and a conditional motion rule.

not_required.rationale: These skills carry no execution surface and no cross-skill boundary contract that a static check would protect today. They may be promoted to required when such a contract is added.

policy.note: Planned entries move into required in the phase named by required_from_phase.
